def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed.

    The same xs and seed always give the same result. The result has the
    same elements as xs with the same multiplicities, and xs is not changed.
    """
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 7) == []
    ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
    ex shuffled([2, 2], 0) == [2, 2]
    m = 2147483648
    out = xs.copy()
    state = (seed % m + m) % m
    i = out.len() - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % m
        j = (state // 65536) % (i + 1)
        tmp = out[i]
        out[i] = out[j]
        out[j] = tmp
        i -= 1
    return out
